name: RELOADIAN
description:
About This Game

Reloadian is a fast-paced action game focused on intense combat and creative build experimentation!

Defeat powerful bosses scattered across the universe and unlock legendary weapons and abilities hidden behind each victory. Every battle rewards you with new options, encouraging you to test different playstyles and discover powerful combinations.

Fight solo or team up in co-op gameplay, where coordination and timing are key to survival. Adapt to relentless enemies, master fluid movement, and push your combat skills to the limit.

With stylish action, replayable runs, and cross-platform play, Reloadian challenges you to forge your own path and define how you fight.

3-Player Co-Op Action

Team up with up to three players and fight through fast-paced sci-fi roguelite missions together. Combine weapons, abilities, and teamwork to survive intense battles and powerful bosses.

Roguelite Missions

Jump into ever-changing missions, collect powerful upgrades, and build a new combat style every run. Adapt your loadout, survive enemy waves, and push deeper toward the boss.

Legendary Weapons & Abilities

Defeat powerful bosses to unlock new weapons and abilities. Experiment with different combinations and create your own combat style with every run.

Fast-Paced Sci-Fi Combat

Dash, strike, shoot, and unleash powerful skills in intense side-scrolling battles. Master movement, timing, and positioning to survive against relentless enemies.

Online Co-Op Multiplayer

Join friends online and fight through dangerous missions together. Coordinate your attacks, share the pressure, and survive as a team.
short_desc: Reloadian is an action roguelike built around fast-paced combat. Combine legendary weapons and restore order to a chaotic universe—solo or with friends.
